name: Sharon Heim
source:
A surface pilot who’s part of the 65th Combat Training Battalion “Infinities”. Cheerful and caring, but sometimes acts stronger than she really is. She has a strong sense of intuition that she puts to good use both in and outside combat. She was once part of Yuuya and Leon’s team.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
